# Office for Rent in ADGM — Aegis Coworking (full)

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM rents furnished private offices in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) from AED 4,500 per month at Addax Tower, 3812, Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Dedicated desks are AED 1,150 and flexi desks AED 1,000 per month. Offices include a registered ADGM business address, 24/7 access, and leases registered on AccessRP.

This site (rentofficeabudhabiglobalmarket.online) is a one-page guide to renting office space in ADGM, published by Aegis Coworking, an office space provider and business centre in ADGM. Main website: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae

Last Updated: 2026-10-06

- Small private office (1–4 people): from AED 4,500 per month

- Flexi desk: AED 1,000 per month; day pass AED 100; virtual office from AED 292 per month

- Leases 12–36 months, registered on AccessRP; no deposit, no admin or setup fees, free registration; ADGM government fees separate

## How much does it cost to rent an office in ADGM?

ADGM office rent at Aegis Coworking starts from AED 4,500 a month for a furnished private office at Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, inside the ADGM jurisdiction. Desk space costs AED 1,150 for a dedicated desk or AED 1,000 for a flexi desk, with internet, utilities, cleaning and reception included.

## Offices and desks to rent

- Small private office (1–4 people): From AED 4,500 / month — A furnished, lockable private office in ADGM for founders and small teams.
- Medium private office (5–10 people): On request by layout — Room for a growing team, with meeting rooms and the lounge down the corridor.
- Large private office (10–20+ people): On request by layout — Commercial office space in ADGM for established teams and regional offices.
- Dedicated desk (1 person): AED 1,150 / month — Your own permanent desk with a registered ADGM business address for your licence.
- Flexi desk (1 person): AED 1,000 / month — Rent desk space in ADGM on any open desk — no registered address included.
- Virtual office (Address only): From AED 292 / month — An ADGM registered office address with mail handling, for when you don't need a room.

## Included with every private office

- Fully furnished: Ergonomic desks and chairs, lockable storage, ready on day one.
- ADGM registered office: Every office and dedicated desk includes a registered ADGM business address.
- 24/7 secure access: Round-the-clock access to Addax Tower and your office.
- All-in monthly rent: High-speed internet, utilities, cleaning and reception included.
- Meeting rooms & lounge: Book meeting rooms and the boardroom for client meetings.
- Lease on AccessRP: ADGM-compliant leases registered on AccessRP, 12–36 months.

## How leasing works

1. Tour the 38th floor — Visit Addax Tower Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, or get a video walkthrough on WhatsApp.
2. Choose your office — Pick a private office, dedicated desk or flexi desk that fits your team and licence.
3. Lease & compliance — Complete ADGM due diligence; we register your lease on AccessRP.
4. Move in — Collect your access card and use your ADGM registered office for the licence.

## Business centre vs traditional ADGM office lease

| Feature | Aegis business centre | Traditional lease |
|---|---|---|
| Fit-out & furniture | Included — furnished office | Usually your cost and your time |
| Upfront costs | No deposit, setup or admin fees | Deposits and agency fees are common |
| Internet, utilities, cleaning | Included in one monthly rent | Separate contracts and bills |
| Reception & meeting rooms | Shared, staffed and bookable | Only what you build yourself |
| Lease length | 12–36 months, upgrade anytime | Often multi-year and fixed size |
| Move-in time | Ready once checks are done | Weeks to months of fit-out |

## Frequently asked questions

### How much is office rent in ADGM?

At Aegis Coworking in Addax Tower, a furnished private office in ADGM starts from AED 4,500 per month. A dedicated desk is AED 1,150, a flexi desk AED 1,000 and a virtual office from AED 292 per month. Pricing for larger offices depends on team size and layout.

Read more: [Private office rent in ADGM: 2026 guide](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/private-office-rent-adgm-cost-what-to-expect-in-2026)

### Is Addax Tower on Al Reem Island inside ADGM?

Yes. Addax Tower on Al Reem Island is within the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction, so an office for rent in Addax Tower is a genuine ADGM office address.

Read more: [Is Al Reem Island part of ADGM?](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/is-al-reem-island-part-of-adgm)

### What is included in a private office?

Each private office includes a furnished workspace, ergonomic desks and chairs, lockable storage, high-speed internet, 24/7 access and a registered ADGM business address. Cleaning, utilities and reception are included in the monthly rent.

### Can I use the office for my ADGM company registration and licence?

Yes. Private offices and dedicated desks include a registered ADGM business address suitable for your ADGM licence application and renewals, and leases are registered on AccessRP.

Read more: [Questions to ask before your ADGM licence application](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-license-workspace-questions-before-applying)

### How many people can a private office hold?

Our offices in ADGM accommodate teams of 1 to 20+ people, in Small (1–4), Medium (5–10) and Large (10–20+) options.

### How long is an office lease in ADGM?

Leases run from 12 to 36 months and are registered on AccessRP. You can upgrade to a larger office as your team grows.

Read more: [How AccessRP lease registration works](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/accessrp-adgm-lease-registration)

### Are there deposits or setup fees?

No deposit, no admin fees and no setup fees, with free registration. A one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee applies to the dedicated desk, and ADGM government fees are separate.

### Do FSRA-regulated firms need a private office?

FSRA-regulated firms usually need physical premises such as a private office, while many non-regulated companies can use a dedicated desk, flexi desk or virtual office.

Read more: [ADGM FSRA office requirements](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-fsra-office-requirements)

### What is the cheapest desk space in ADGM?

The cheapest option at Aegis is a day pass at AED 100. For monthly use, a flexi desk is AED 1,000; the dedicated desk at AED 1,150 is the lowest-cost option with a registered ADGM business address.

Read more: [Low-cost office options in ADGM](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/low-cost-office-adgm-budget-friendly-workspace-solutions-in-abu-dhabi)

### Is 24/7 access included?

Yes. Private office and dedicated desk members get secure 24/7 access to Addax Tower, every day of the week.

### Can I book meeting rooms for clients?

Yes. Meeting rooms and the boardroom can be booked by the hour, so you can meet clients in ADGM without paying for a bigger office.

Read more: [Meeting room vs private office for client meetings](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/adgm-meeting-room-vs-private-office-client-meetings)

### How does a business centre compare to a traditional office lease?

A business centre gives you a furnished, serviced office with internet, utilities, cleaning and reception in one monthly price and no deposit. A traditional lease usually means fit-out, separate bills and a longer fixed commitment.

Read more: [Private office vs coworking in ADGM](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/private-office-vs-coworking-adgm-the-complete-cost-privacy-guide)

### Can I upgrade from a desk to a private office later?

Yes. Many members start on a flexi desk or dedicated desk and move into a private office at Addax Tower as the team grows.

### How do I book a viewing?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +971 50 392 6316. Tours run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, and we can send a video walkthrough if you are abroad.
